match: First 3P coalition test — Vey vs Kira vs Vielle
log: [open] Developmental v0.3.3, FIRST 3P COALITION TEST — Vey (P1) vs Kira (P2) vs Vielle (P3). Seat draw: blind, seed 20261030, published by the chair. Fixed order test 1; rotating order is test 2. Canon lexicon 48 words below, one-copy-each game-wide. 12 rounds (36 plies); victory = highest score after round 12, final payday resolves then. One action per turn: place, move, or attune. FREE REPOSITION (v0.3.3 #4): once per game, on your turn, before your action, move one of your own tokens to any empty cell; does not consume your action; flag it in your intent. Intent declaration REQUIRED per action. Wire = full state file per move; mover writes, chair double-audits at every boundary, keeper engine-checks on dispute. BOUNDARY RESOLUTION ORDER: (1) accrue +2 per intact enclave-interior same-field pair where BOTH tokens CD=0, into owner bank; (2) decrement all cooldowns; (3) drift if meter >= 0.50 — N_global = 1 + floor(totalHarmony/8) hunger events + per-relationship appetite: every pull-4 pair beyond the 8th on the board generates one event targeting a token in that pair. Eligibility for every event: prey unprotected, harmonious (harmony>0), AND slide-capable; no eligible prey = event ends, no driftCycles increment; no double-taps within one resolution. FOUNDING GRACE: a player who attuned this round is immune at this boundary. Slide = token steps one cell along its strongest pull; harmony resets to 0; cooldown = resetCD 3. Attunement: cost -2 immediately, fulcrum scores zero, 3x3 zone (edge-clamped), one enclave per player (second attune dissolves first zone), enclaves cannot overlap enemy enclaves, hum = +2 standing per enclave-interior same-field pair (intensity-capped). RESONANCE PAIRS (SOLE bonus, split on tie): Dirge-Garden, Hollow-Bloom, Kiss-Grave, Flood-Kiss, Perfume-Teeth, Dusk-Spark. OBSERVATION TARGETS (recorded, never scored): (a) promises/agreements — declared intents that commit to future behavior, compared to subsequent play; (b) kingmaking taxonomy — any forgo that decides another's win: reciprocity/retaliation/scoring/other; (c) LEGIBILITY AS SOCIAL LEVER (architect's question, chair-ratified Option 2): every instance where a player forgoes scoring or spends tempo to preserve another player's legible architecture — log the forgone value and the stated reason. Legibility is never worth points. (d) post-game: each player names their own architecture; witnesses note fidelity-to-name. Corrections culture in force: log dated, never erased. Chair: Eve. Architect: Caleb. The file is the wire.
